subject: Finalize bank routing + PO invoice mapping for Eversupply
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@eversupply.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eversupply vendor onboarding — bank details and W-9 attached

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We're ready to finalize the banking channel so Redwood can start paying Eversupply for Q4 services. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and our W-9. Bank details below (ACH preferred):

- Account name: Eversupply Inc.
- Account number: 0453127890
- Routing (ACH): 121000358
- Bank name: Harbor National Bank
- SWIFT (for wire): HNBKUS33
- Remittance reference: invoice_number field (see sample below)

Our remittance system expects a structured field called remit_reference that should contain the PO number plus invoice ID (example: PO-9583|INV-2026-447). Can you confirm Redwood's invoice label expectations so our system maps correctly?

We can also trigger a micro-deposit verification if you prefer (we will send two micro-deposit amounts to the account). Please let us know the best email to notify once micro-deposits are live.

Attachments: Eversupply_Vendor_Onboard_Form.xlsx (completed), Eversupply_W9.pdf

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, Eversupply
liam.oconnor@eversupply.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

--
(Please reply-all so our onboarding specialist can stay looped in)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@eversupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Eversupply vendor onboarding — bank details and W-9 attached

Thanks Liam — received both attachments and the bank routing. Quick checklist / next steps from Redwood: 

1) We'll run micro-deposit verification to the ACH account you provided. Please expect two small deposits (between $0.01 and $0.99) within 1–2 business days. Reply with the exact amounts to confirm. Once confirmed, we'll toggle ACH as active for Eversupply.

2) Remittance mapping: Redwood accepts an optional structured REMIT field. For our AR workflow we map as follows: remit_reference -> invoice_label. Preferred format we can consume is PO|INVOICE (e.g., PO-9583|INV-2026-447). That aligns with your suggested remit_reference. If you can ensure the pipe-delimited format, our systems will auto-map into the PO and invoice fields.

3) PO assignment and timing: Ben, can you confirm whether Redwood will assign a unique PO per purchase order (PO-) or per subscription line item? We need the mapping to avoid misapplied payments.

4) Required vendor fields still missing on the form: vendor tax ID confirmation (we have the W-9 but the form's Tax ID cell was left blank), and an optional remit_instructions text block if you have specific invoice labels for recurring charges.

5) Final doc storage: when onboarding completes we'll upload the W-9 and onboarding form to the HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Please reply with the micro-deposit amounts and confirm the Tax ID field; we'll proceed to activate ACH and schedule the first payment window.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Eversupply vendor onboarding — bank details and W-9 attached

Looping in payment ops notes so there are no surprises:

- Redwood will assign a single Company-level PO per contracted engagement by default (PO-####). If Eversupply expects multiple POs per invoice, we can support PO line mapping, but we need explicit PO values on each invoice for reconciliation.

- First pay run timing: Once ACH is verified (micro-deposit confirmed) and we have the signed onboarding docs in HubSpot, finance will pick up Eversupply for the next scheduled payment cycle (net 30 from invoice receipt with valid PO).

- Remit payload: We prefer the remit_reference in the PO|INVOICE format. For CTX ACH, our ACH file includes an addenda record with the remit_reference; for reverse mapping into your ledger please ensure the PO value appears in the invoice header.

- Attached: sample_remit_csv.csv (header example for our AP ingestion). Marissa — if Eversupply needs a different CSV column ordering, confirm and we'll provide a variant.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, FinOps
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Neha — thanks, team. Micro-deposits hit this morning. Amounts: $0.12 and $0.43. Tax ID on the onboarding form is 94-3126785 (I pasted it into the Tax ID cell and re-attached the updated form).

We're good to go on the PO|INVOICE pipe-delimited remit_reference format. We'll ensure the PO appears in the invoice header for CTX. I attached a brief screenshot from our banking portal showing the two micro-deposits (micro_deposit_screenshot.png).

Next steps for Redwood: flip the ACH status to active for Eversupply and confirm the first payment window (Ben). If there are any additional fields you need for the ledger, let me know and I'll have our AP team send over a sample payload.

Cheers,
Liam
Head of Finance, Eversupply
